text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on October 11 and 12, 2023. October 11, 2023 Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, called upon Mayor Olivia Chow to address City Council to commemorate the 140th anniversary of Public Health in Toronto. Mayor Chow recognized the efforts of the dedicated staff at Toronto Public Health, bearing responsibility for the health and well-being of Toronto residents. Mayor Chow acknowledged and thanked the public health staff for their incredible efforts in delivering vital health programs and services for almost a century and a half making Toronto a healthier and safer city.
